en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a central stone monument on a stepped base surrounded by an iron fence. Around the fenced monument are several canvas tents, with people and belongings visible near them, suggesting temporary shelter in a damaged urban area. In the background are low, partially ruined buildings and a cloudy sky. The lower border of the postcard contains printed Greek and English captions identifying the location as Solomos Place in Zante (Zakynthos), along with a website watermark and publisher details.
